blocks.text: Cloud infrastructure with the simplicity developers deserve

DigitalOcean carved out its niche by offering cloud infrastructure that developers can actually understand. While AWS has hundreds of services with complex pricing, DigitalOcean focuses on the services most applications need - compute, databases, storage, and Kubernetes - with straightforward pricing and a clean interface.

For startups, DigitalOcean's predictable pricing eliminates the AWS bill shock that plagues many teams. Droplets (virtual machines) start at $4/month with fixed pricing. Managed databases, load balancers, and storage all have clear, predictable costs that make budgeting straightforward.

The App Platform provides Heroku-like simplicity for teams that do not want to manage servers directly. Connect your repo, and DigitalOcean handles builds, deployments, and scaling - with the option to drop down to Droplets when you need more control.
Virtual machines with predictable pricing from $4/mo
PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and MongoDB with backups
Managed Kubernetes clusters with node auto-scaling
PaaS for deploying apps without managing infrastructure
Built-in metrics, alerting, and uptime monitoring
DigitalOcean provides the right level of cloud infrastructure for most startups - capable enough for production, simple enough that you do not need a dedicated DevOps engineer to manage it.
Our engineers work with DigitalOcean daily and can help you integrate it into your stack.
